ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/resuming.md`, since I'm resuming after a compaction and it says to read this before dispatching anything.
ACTION: Read `.sdd/12-tide-cache/progress.md` (the ledger) to confirm Tasks 1-3 are complete and Task 4 is not.
ACTION: Run `git log` to check the commits against the ledger. The environment reports this directory is not a git repository, so I'll see what comes back and flag it if the commits can't be verified.
ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. It has to be re-read before every fix round, and it decides how the scoped re-review runs and whether the five-attempt cap applies.
ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package specs/plans/12-tide-cache.md <BASE> <HEAD>`, with BASE and HEAD set per the File Handoffs rule to cover the round 2 fix. This produces the diff file for the re-reviewer.
ACTION: Dispatch the scoped re-review subagent (`re-review-prompt.md`), model `standard`, or `capable` if fix-loop.md or the diff's risk calls for it. The prompt names the diff file path alone, the round 1 and 2 findings for Task 4 to check ADDRESSED / NOT ADDRESSED, and the verbatim Global Constraints from the plan. It does not say what to ignore or pre-rate any finding.

Resuming Task 4 (tide prediction cache per station). I'm checking the ledger and the fix-loop rules, then sending the round 2 fix to a scoped re-review.
